summary: Ford Motor Co. filed an 8-K reporting the closing of transactions under a Joint Venture Disposition Agreement related to BlueOval SK (BOSK), a JV with SK On for EV battery plants. Ford redeemed its membership interest in BOSK, terminated its $6.6B capital commitment, and acquired BOSK's Kentucky battery plant interests via wholly owned subsidiary Ford Energy Battery LLC. Ford assumed $3.805B of DOE loan obligations at 4.814% interest, with quarterly interest-only payments through Jan 2030 then P&I. Ford was released from its guarantee under the Sponsor Support Agreement. The restructuring reflects Ford's shift in EV battery strategy; watch for operational execution and DOE loan compliance.
